card.title: Exactly as Planned
card.instruction: Treat every exposed flaw, failed step, and unexpected consequence as proof that the scheme is unfolding by design.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum found the surprise-party invitations. Right on schedule.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made me hide them in my sock drawer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She had to feel she'd uncovered it herself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's cancelling the caterer. She hates surprises.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's her part of the plan: taking control. We surprise her with how completely we obey.

mechanism: A claims the exposure and collapse of a surprise party were intentionally arranged to let Mum take control.
confusable: Unlike celebrating a newly improved plan, A must describe the unwanted consequence as previously intended.
comparison: A family host's cancellation becomes her assigned role, unlike the escape-room scene's claimed record exit.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
